title: Lockout during equipment servicing
note: A worker was servicing a machine without lockout devices secured to all energy isolation points. Which general-industry standard covers that?

record.label: OSHA citation as issued
record.summary: OSHA cited the employer under § 1910.147(d)(4)(i) for failing to affix a lockout or tagout device to each energy-isolating device. Inspection 1048428.

title: Exposed rotating lathe chuck
note: A lathe's rotating chuck was exposed while the machine was in use. Find the standard on guarding operators from rotating machine parts.

record.label: OSHA citation · abatement completed
record.summary: OSHA cited an unguarded lathe chuck under § 1910.212(a)(1). The record lists a final order dated April 4, 2012. Inspection 191510.015, citation 01001.

title: Stockroom exit blocked by merchandise
note: Merchandise and rolling carts blocked a stockroom emergency exit. Find the OSHA standard on keeping exit routes clear.

record.label: OSHA citation · abatement completed
record.summary: OSHA cited a blocked stockroom exit and obstructed panic hardware under § 1910.37(a)(3). The record lists a formal settlement in August 2024. Inspection 1635689.015, citation 01001.

title: Blower wiring under the passenger dash
note: The blower motor wiring connector under the passenger dash can be struck by a passenger's foot and overheat. Which recall covers the connector?

record.label: NHTSA recall record
record.summary: NHTSA campaign 10V001000 covers certain 2006 and 2007 Honda Ridgelines with a blower motor wiring connector that can overheat after being struck.
